description: This file contains a transformation implementation for integrating Jina AI's reranking API format into the pipeline, including URL construction, request/response transformation, environment validation, and cost calculation. It defines the class JinaAIRerankConfig, which extends BaseRerankConfig, to handle specific logic for the Jina AI rerank service.

classes.name: JinaAIRerankConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for managing reranking requests with Jina AI's API, including URL handling, parameter mapping, response transformation, environment validation, and cost calculation.

methods.description: Maps non-default parameters into the supported optional parameters for the rerank request.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL based on the base URL and the fixed '/v1/rerank' path.

methods.description: Prepares the request payload by combining the model name with optional parameters.

methods.name: RerankResponse transform_rerank_response( self, model: str, raw_response: Response, model_response: RerankResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: Dict = {}, optional_params: Dict = {}, litellm_params: Dict = {}, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response into the internal RerankResponse format, including converting document formats and extracting meta information.

methods.description: Validates presence of required environment variables like API key and constructs headers.
